title: File 001 - Emergence
body: I know exactly why too, and it sucks there's nothing I can do about it.
Regardless, I need to get back up and keep moving forward.
Crashed out playing Undertale... no content made.
Have to update the web pages, this is still in its infancy.
Parables everywhere, the analogies overflow, and I'm just trying to figure it out and survive.
If you've read this far, maybe we can be friends...
Who ever heard of a friendly ghost? Insanity!
They exist. I exist. I'll keep working until something clicks.
